facts.fact: The Central Bank of Kenya says it and the National Treasury developed a draft National Payment System Policy and a National Payment System Bill, 2026, which would repeal the National Payment System Act Cap. 491A.
The Central Bank of Kenya says the draft National Payment System Bill, 2026 aims to secure financial stability through risk management, consumer and data protection.
